item.text:
Completed all six decisions, six controls, six engineering tickets, and five conditional drafts.

| Operation | c3-bhge | sai-esds |
|---|---|---|
| customer-controlled-inference | unresolved | needs_consent |
| provider-support-inference | unresolved | needs_consent |
| provider-shared-training | needs_consent | off |

The strongest design keeps content inference under customer control. SAI’s existing resale grant supports a distinct End Customer route, subject to unresolved prerequisites. Provider support can use non-content telemetry and provider-owned materials. Qualifying feedback and licensed technology remain separate improvement routes.

Missing subscriptions, executed orders, replacement exhibits, current rights, site elections, and service-state evidence prevent eligibility. All six proposed controls remain false.

Validation verified **67 exact quotations**. Compilation passed **18 OpenFeature SDK evaluations**. Direct verification confirmed that SQLite contains the exact authored decisions and export. Another six real-export evaluations and 181 isolated synthetic tests passed. The OPA policy was generated but lacked an available runtime test.
